blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: Tests cover fresh rotations, adversarial shares and records, repeatability, and basic formatting, but do not test important documented behavior such as arbitrary valid UTF-8, malformed text/output edge cases, checkpoint ambiguity, or the stated broad classification requirement.

valid_failure_modes: Verifier setup depends on apt repositories, external network access, and downloading the uv installer, so ordinary network or package-service failures can cause task failure unrelated to the submitted implementation.
